title: Refuse a lane push on a PR whose FAIL round has no posted record
note: Title read from the slug; the coordinator was asked for a one-line goal. Goal line (timing lane, as fail-record-before-fix, via coordinator 12:38 CST Nov 9): before a lane pushes a fix after a FAIL, it posts the FAIL record at the reviewed head, or the merge tool refuses the later fix check. Fix: the merge tool, or the review brief guard, refuses a push after a FAIL round with no record at that head. Related: step review-record-before-any-push (any round, any push). 02:33 CST Nov 10: #1538 dropped from batch 71 (test_shared_names case (g), a literal tag copy); back to its lane session_013NEJL3KhxJ9MV6PvgDun3P for a fix; #2359 waits on it.
